answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: each agent locks real capital to earn an identity, so spinning up a thousand clones is no longer free. Fake identities become costly rather than a cheap mirror of a real one. Picture bonds moored like boats along a jetty, each tied to a verifiable deposit; a sybil swarm trying to flood the economy would have to buy a whole dune of collateral it cannot recover if it misbehaves, since slashing burns the bond on bad behavior.
